target: Мы поехали за город на машине.
english: We went outside the city by car.
grammar: За город means 'outside the city/to the countryside.' На машине = by car (на + prepositional for transport).

target: Она гуляет с собакой два раза в день.
english: She walks the dog twice a day.
The table is covered with a white tablecloth.
The children listened to music in the evening.
grammar: Вечером = in the evening (instrumental for time). Слушали is past plural – дети слушали. Plural past always ends in -ли.

english: The students watched a movie in the evening.
The cat plays with a ball of yarn.
It seems to me that he is right.
I am getting used to the new city.
grammar: Привыкать к + dative = to get used to: к новому городу. К + dative is used with verbs of adaptation and movement toward.

english: The boy talked on the phone long ago.

target: Мы встретились с родителями в парке.
english: We met with our parents in the park.

target: Папа редко пишет письмо в библиотеке.
english: Dad rarely writes a letter in the library.
grammar: Редко (rarely) signals infrequent action. В библиотеке = in the library (prepositional). Пишет письмо = writes a letter.

target: Художник всегда слушает музыку на работе.
english: The artist always listens to music at work.

target: Музыкант всегда поёт песню на работе.
english: The musician always sings a song at work.

target: Папа обычно смотрит фильм в парке.
english: Dad usually watches a movie in the park.
grammar: Обычно (usually) signals habitual action. В парке = in the park (prepositional). Смотрит фильм = watches a film.

target: Папа иногда слушает музыку в аэропорту.
english: Dad sometimes listens to music at the airport.

target: Сестра часто читает книгу в библиотеке.
english: Sister often reads a book at the library.

target: Иногда повар готовит обед на вокзале.
english: Sometimes the chef cooks lunch at the station.

target: Каждый день друг готовит обед дома.
english: Every day the friend cooks lunch at home.

target: Сегодня утром ребёнок готовит обед дома.
english: This morning the child cooks lunch at home.

target: Журналист плавал в бассейне на прошлой неделе.
english: The journalist swam in the pool last week.

target: Девочка мыла посуду дома на прошлой неделе.
english: The girl washed dishes at home last week.
grammar: Мыла is past feminine imperfective (agreeing with девочка). Дома = at home. На прошлой неделе = last week.

target: Сосед обычно играет в шахматы в библиотеке.
english: The neighbor usually plays chess in the library.
grammar: Играть в + accusative for games: в шахматы. В библиотеке = in the library (prepositional). Обычно = usually.

target: Архитектор стирал одежду дома на прошлой неделе.
english: The architect did laundry at home last week.
grammar: Стирать одежду means 'to do laundry.' Стирал is past masculine imperfective. На прошлой неделе = last week.

target: Мама смотрит фильм на работе по выходным.
english: Mom watches a movie at work on weekends.
grammar: На работе = at work (prepositional for location). По выходным = on weekends (по + dative plural for recurring events).

target: Студенты на прошлой неделе говорили по телефону.
english: The students talked on the phone last week.

target: Программист редко гуляет в парке дома.
english: The programmer rarely walks in the park at home.
grammar: Редко (rarely) signals infrequent action. Гулять в парке = to walk in the park. Дома here seems contradictory – likely a data issue.

target: Медсестра редко учит язык в библиотеке.
english: The nurse rarely studies a language in the library.
grammar: Редко signals infrequent action. В библиотеке = in the library. Учить язык = to study a language (imperfective).

target: Архитектор всегда поёт песню в библиотеке.
english: The architect always sings a song in the library.

target: Инженер танцует вальс в горах завтра.
english: The engineer dances a waltz in the mountains tomorrow.

target: Водитель редко поёт песню в магазине.
english: The driver rarely sings a song in the store.
grammar: Редко (rarely) signals infrequent action. В магазине = in the store. Петь песню = to sing a song (песню is accusative).

target: Завтра музыкант читает книгу в ресторане.
english: Tomorrow the musician reads a book in the restaurant.

target: Сейчас писатель бегает утром в школе.
english: Now the writer runs in the morning at school.

target: Всего хорошего, берегите себя в дороге!
english: All the best, take care of yourself on the road!

target: Разрешите представиться, меня зовут Сергей Николаевич.
english: Allow me to introduce myself, my name is Sergey Nikolaevich.

target: Завтра студент бегает утром в магазине.
english: Tomorrow the student runs in the morning in the store.
grammar: Бегать is imperfective multidirectional – for habitual running. Утром = in the morning (instrumental). В магазине = in the store.

target: Всего хорошего, берегите себя и свою семью.
english: All the best, take care of yourself and your family.

target: Я встаю в семь утра каждый день.
english: I get up at seven in the morning every day.
grammar: Reflexive verbs add -ся/-сь: учиться → учусь, учишься, учится.

target: Программист ездит на работу в музее перед сном.
english: The programmer commutes to work in the museum before bed.

target: На прошлой неделе повар рисовал картину в ресторане.
english: Last week the chef painted a picture in the restaurant.
grammar: Рисовал is past imperfective – the drawing was in progress or habitual. На прошлой неделе = last week. В ресторане = in the restaurant.

target: Пока он ждал поезд, он читал книгу.
english: While he was waiting for the train, he read a book.
grammar: The prepositional case is used after о, в, and на for location.

target: Тепло улыбаясь, она протянула руку и представилась новому коллеге.
english: Smiling warmly, she extended her hand and introduced herself to the new colleague.
She turns around.
grammar: Reflexive verbs end in -ся or -сь: умываться, одеваться.

english: Tell about yourself!
Take care of yourself!
He will cook dinner.
grammar: Будет готовить is imperfective future (буду + infinitive): he will be cooking. This implies an ongoing future activity.

english: She will cook dinner.
You will cook dinner.
She thinks about the future.
grammar: Думать о + prepositional = to think about: о будущем. Будущее (future) is a neuter noun, prepositional form будущем.

english: The singer's voice sounds wonderful.
We were preparing for departure.
grammar: Готовиться к + dative = to prepare for: к отъезду. The -ся suffix makes this reflexive: 'to prepare oneself.'

english: I worry before the exam.
grammar: Many reflexive verbs describe daily routines: умываться, одеваться, причёсываться.

english: She stops by the window.
grammar: Many reflexive verbs describe daily routines: умываться, одеваться, причёсываться.

english: The doctor ate soup recently.
Father worked at home recently.
The boy bought bread recently.
They drank tea long ago.
The students will cook dinner.
I will read this book.
I will call you tomorrow.
grammar: Позвоню is perfective future of позвонить – I will call (completed action). Perfective verbs in present-form conjugation express future.

english: Heavy rain is falling outside.
She complains about a headache.
grammar: Reflexive verbs end in -ся or -сь: умываться, одеваться.

english: We agree with this plan.
grammar: Соглашаться с + instrumental = to agree with: с этим планом. The -ся ending here does not indicate a daily routine.

english: They built their house themselves.
The doctor studied Russian recently.

target: Отец на прошлой неделе играл в футбол.
english: Father played football last week.
I am afraid of the dark.
grammar: Бояться + genitive = to be afraid of: темноты (of darkness). Бояться is always reflexive – it has no non-reflexive form.

english: The artist runs in the afternoon.
They used to meet every day.
grammar: Встречаться is a reciprocal reflexive verb: they met each other. Каждый день = every day signals habitual past action.

english: She promises to come on time.
grammar: Обещаться means 'to promise' (colloquial reflexive form of обещать). Прийти вовремя = to come on time (perfective infinitive).

english: I am amazed by his talent.
grammar: Reflexive verbs end in -ся or -сь: умываться, одеваться.

english: He is smarter than he seems.
grammar: Simple comparative: add -ее/-ей to adjective stem: красивее (more beautiful).

english: The student listened to music recently.
grammar: Недавно = recently. Слушал is past masculine imperfective of слушать. Past masculine ends in -л (no extra ending).

english: The boy opened the door recently.
grammar: Открыл is past masculine perfective of открыть – completed action. Недавно (recently) pairs well with perfective past.

english: The sister wrote a letter recently.
The girl closed the window recently.
Mom bakes a pie with apples.
grammar: Печь (to bake) is irregular: пеку, печёшь, печёт. С + instrumental: с яблоками = with apples. Пирог = pie/cake.

english: Tall pines grow around the lake.
She goes to bed at ten.
grammar: Ложиться спать means 'to go to bed.' Ложиться is reflexive – it means 'to lay oneself down.' В десять = at ten.

english: I studied Russian in the morning.
grammar: The past tense is formed by replacing -ть with -л for masculine subjects.

english: We buy groceries at the market.

target: Мы мечтаем о путешествии по Европе.
english: We dream about traveling through Europe.

target: Они на прошлой неделе открыли дверь.
english: They opened the door last week.
grammar: Они открыли is past plural – все plural subjects use -ли ending regardless of gender. На прошлой неделе = last week.

english: They are getting acquainted with the neighbors.
grammar: Знакомиться с + instrumental = to get acquainted with: с соседями. This is a reciprocal reflexive – mutual introduction.

english: He worked at home in the evening.
grammar: Работал is regular past masculine of работать. Вечером = in the evening (instrumental). Дома = at home.

english: She watched a movie in the morning.
We listened to music in the evening.
grammar: Plural past tense always ends in -ли regardless of gender.

english: They worked at home in the evening.
The children wrote a letter long ago.
The friends watched a movie long ago.
Mom paints a picture in the evening.
The boy sometimes washes dishes at home.
The bright sun shines in the eyes.
Fresh fruits are sold at the market.

target: Сок из свежих апельсинов очень вкусный.
english: Juice from fresh oranges is very tasty.

target: В деревне свежий воздух и тишина.
english: The village has fresh air and silence.

target: Врач на прошлой неделе написал письмо.
english: The doctor wrote a letter last week.

target: Мальчик на прошлой неделе закрыл окно.
english: The boy closed the window last week.
grammar: Закрыл is past masculine perfective of закрыть (to close). На прошлой неделе = last week. Окно is neuter accusative.

target: В лесу растут грибы и ягоды.
english: Mushrooms and berries grow in the forest.
grammar: В лесу uses the special prepositional form -у (instead of -е) for лес. Some masculine nouns take stressed -у: в лесу, в саду, на полу.

target: Завтра папа покупает продукты в парке.
english: Tomorrow dad buys groceries in the park.
The girl wrote a letter in the evening.
grammar: Написала is past feminine perfective of написать – she wrote/finished writing. Вечером = in the evening (instrumental).

english: The walls of this castle are very thick.
The driver drives the bus in the mornings.

target: Учитель всегда моет посуду в театре.
english: The teacher always washes dishes in the theater.

target: Сестра редко слушает музыку в аэропорту.
english: Sister rarely listens to music at the airport.
grammar: The prepositional case is used after о, в, and на for location.

target: Всегда сестра убирает квартиру на рынке.
english: Always sister cleans the apartment at the market.

target: Обычно ребёнок помогает другу на работе.
english: Usually the child helps a friend at work.
grammar: Обычно (usually) signals habitual action. Помогать + dative: помогает другу. На работе = at work (prepositional for location, not motion).

target: Сейчас брат пишет письмо на вокзале.
english: Now brother writes a letter at the station.

target: Завтра программист покупает продукты в магазине.
english: Tomorrow the programmer buys groceries in the store.

target: Дети на прошлой неделе гуляли в парке.
english: The children walked in the park last week.

target: Снежинки тихо кружились в холодном зимнем воздухе.
english: Snowflakes quietly swirled in the cold winter air.

target: Сегодня утром папа помогает другу на работе.
english: This morning dad helps a friend at work.
grammar: Помогать + dative: помогает другу = helps a friend. Сегодня утром = this morning. На работе = at work (prepositional).

target: На прошлой неделе брат играл в шахматы в ресторане.
english: Last week brother played chess in the restaurant.

target: Мальчик часто убирает квартиру в музее.
english: The boy often cleans the apartment in the museum.
grammar: Часто (often) signals habitual action. В музее = in the museum (prepositional). Убирать квартиру = to clean the apartment.

target: Часто фермер слушает музыку в магазине.
english: Often the farmer listens to music in the store.

target: В понедельник художник покупает продукты в театре.
english: On monday the artist buys groceries in the theater.

target: Каждый день брат читает книгу в парке.
english: Every day brother reads a book in the park.

target: Орёл кружит величественно над заснеженными горными вершинами.
english: The eagle circles majestically above the snow-covered mountain peaks.

target: Благодарность наполнила его сердце после доброго поступка соседа.
english: Gratitude filled his heart after the neighbor's kind deed.
grammar: Благодарность наполнила – abstract noun as subject with perfective past verb. После + genitive: после поступка = after the deed.

english: There is a large selection of goods in the store.
grammar: В магазине = in the store (prepositional). Большой выбор товаров = a big selection of goods – genitive plural after выбор.

target: Часто художник бегает утром на вокзале.
english: Often the artist runs in the morning at the station.
grammar: В + prepositional = location inside: в городе (in the city), в школе (in school).

target: Вечером библиотекарь покупает продукты в аэропорту.
english: In the evening the librarian buys groceries at the airport.

target: В понедельник художник читает книгу на рынке.
english: On monday the artist reads a book at the market.

target: В понедельник писатель помогает другу в больнице.
english: On monday the writer helps a friend at the hospital.
grammar: В понедельник = on Monday (accusative for days). Помогать + dative: помогает другу. В больнице = in the hospital.

target: Сегодня утром друг слушает музыку в магазине.
english: This morning the friend listens to music in the store.
grammar: This в + acc. vs в + prep. distinction is fundamental: в город (to the city) vs в городе (in the city).

target: Она села в лужу на собеседовании, забыв имя директора.
english: She embarrassed herself at the interview, forgetting the director's name.
grammar: Сесть в лужу = to sit in a puddle, meaning 'to embarrass oneself.' На собеседовании = at the interview (prepositional).

target: Пчеловод собрал золотистый мёд из ульев на пасеке.
english: The beekeeper harvested golden honey from the hives at the apiary.

target: Разрешите представиться, я директор этого отдела.
english: Allow me to introduce myself, I am the director of this department.

target: Лучница попала в центр мишени с максимальной дистанции.
english: The archer hit the center of the target from the maximum distance.
grammar: Попасть в + accusative = to hit: попала в центр мишени. С + genitive: с максимальной дистанции = from maximum distance.

english: We will buy groceries.
It will rain tomorrow.
We will help mom.
I wrote yesterday work.
I bought groceries yesterday.
He helped me yesterday.
grammar: Помочь + dative: помог мне = he helped me. Мне is dative of я. Вчера (yesterday) signals past perfective помог.

english: I will open the window.
grammar: Открою is perfective future of открыть – I will open (completed action). Perfective verbs conjugated in present form express future.

english: I wrote a letter recently.
grammar: Мочь in past tense: мог, могла, могли – note the stem vowel change.

english: She wrote a letter recently.
He will rest at home.
They will rest at home.
The students will help mom.
I did yesterday an exercise.
I built yesterday a lesson.
I received yesterday a poem.
grammar: Получил is past perfective of получить – a completed reception. Вчера (yesterday) + perfective = specific completed past event.

english: I lost yesterday a task.
I found yesterday an exercise.
Grandmother rarely helps a friend.
She teaches mathematics at school.
Children play at the playground.
The children will play football.
I finished work early today.
grammar: Закончил is past perfective of закончить – I finished (completed). Рано (early) + сегодня (today) = early today.

english: I wrote a letter long ago.
grammar: The past tense is formed by replacing -ть with -л for masculine subjects.

english: The book is on the table.
grammar: На + prepositional = location 'on/at': на столе, на работе.

english: I will wait for the bus.
We will wait for the bus.
They will wait for the bus.
grammar: Буду conjugates: буду, будешь, будет, будем, будете, будут.

english: The students will write a letter.
The children will write a letter.
grammar: Будут писать is imperfective future (будут + infinitive) – they will be writing. Used for ongoing or habitual future action.

english: They bought in the morning dinner.
The teacher explained the new topic.
grammar: Many perfective verbs are formed by adding a prefix: писать → написать.

english: Hot porridge is on the table.
Will you have dinner with us?
Grandfather often swims in the pool.
She showed photographs to all friends.
grammar: Показывать + dative: показывала фотографии друзьям = showed photos to friends. Всем is dative plural of все (everyone).

english: She showed me a new painting.

target: Мальчик на прошлой неделе ел суп.
english: The boy ate soup last week.

target: Они на прошлой неделе смотрели фильм.
english: They watched a movie last week.
grammar: Смотрели is past plural of смотреть (regular). На прошлой неделе = last week. Они signals plural past (-ли ending).

target: Девочка на прошлой неделе играла в теннис.
english: The girl played tennis last week.
The student worked at home long ago.
The book is lying on the shelf.
The athlete rarely runs in the morning.
They cooked in the morning a book.
grammar: Приготовили is past plural perfective of приготовить – they prepared (completed). Утром = in the morning (instrumental).

english: They learned in the morning a house.
They opened in the morning a rule.
grammar: Открыли is past plural perfective – they opened (completed). Утром = in the morning. Правило = a rule (neuter noun).

english: They decided in the morning a book.
The student walked in the park recently.
The cook chops vegetables in the kitchen.
A golden ring shines in the sun.
grammar: Prepositional case is used ONLY after prepositions – it never appears alone.

english: Everyone is talking about the upcoming holiday.
The children will walk in the park.
The friend often walks in the park.
I used to buy every day dinner.
Now the nurse washes dishes at home.
grammar: Сейчас (now) + imperfective моет = right now washing. Present imperfective for ongoing current action.

english: She needs to buy a new coat.
grammar: Ей нужно + infinitive = she needs to. Нужно is impersonal, dative ей marks who needs. Купить is perfective infinitive.

english: He needs to call the plumber today.

target: У нас нет молока в холодильнике.
english: We don't have milk in the refrigerator.

target: Друзья встречаются в кафе по пятницам.
english: Friends meet at the cafe on Fridays.

target: Мой друг изучает историю в университете.
english: My friend studies history at the university.

target: Мы каждое утро бегаем в парке.
english: We run in the park every morning.

target: Дети играют во дворе после школы.
english: Children play in the yard after school.

target: Сестра плавает в бассейне каждый день.
english: Sister swims in the pool every day.

target: Брат всегда моет посуду в музее.
english: Brother always washes dishes in the museum.

target: Дети получали подарки на каждый праздник.
english: The children received gifts on every holiday.

target: Дети получили подарки на Новый год.
english: The children received gifts for New Year.

target: Сегодня утром брат стирает одежду дома.
english: This morning brother does laundry at home.
grammar: Сегодня утром = this morning. Стирать одежду = to do laundry (imperfective for current/habitual action). Дома = at home.

target: Завтра бабушка смотрит фильм в школе.
english: Tomorrow grandmother watches a movie at school.
grammar: Завтра (tomorrow) + present tense for scheduled events: бабушка смотрит фильм завтра. В школе = at school (prepositional).

target: Ей нужно купить новые зимние сапоги.
english: She needs to buy new winter boots.

target: Мама на прошлой неделе гуляла в парке.
english: Mom walked in the park last week.
grammar: На прошлой неделе = last week. Гуляла is past feminine imperfective (agreeing with мама). В парке = in the park.

target: Мы на прошлой неделе гуляли в парке.
english: We walked in the park last week.

target: Вы будете учить новые слова каждый день.
english: You will learn new words every day.

target: Бабушка всегда играет в шахматы в горах.
english: Grandmother always plays chess in the mountains.
They helped for a long time a book.
The neighbor waters the flowers on the balcony.
A glass of water is on the table.
grammar: В + prepositional = location inside: в городе (in the city), в школе (in school).

english: A parent meeting is taking place at school.
I used to open the window every morning.
grammar: Открывал is past imperfective – repeated action. Каждое утро (every morning) confirms habitual past: I used to open the window.

target: Мой сосед слушает музыку по вечерам.
english: My neighbor listens to music in the evenings.

target: Кошка спит на диване целый день.
english: The cat sleeps on the sofa all day.

target: Птицы поют в саду каждое утро.
english: The birds sing in the garden every morning.
grammar: Prepositional is the simplest case – only two main endings: -е and -и.

target: Мы изучаем историю России в школе.
english: We study the history of Russia at school.

target: Сестра редко танцует вальс на пляже.
english: Sister rarely dances a waltz at the beach.
grammar: Masculine/neuter endings: -е (городе, окне). Feminine: -е (школе) or -и (ночи).

target: Медсестра редко покупает продукты в горах.
english: The nurse rarely buys groceries in the mountains.

target: Сейчас продавец ездит на работу дома.
english: Now the salesman commutes to work at home.
grammar: Сейчас (now) + imperfective ездит = right now commuting. Present imperfective for current habitual action. Дома seems contradictory.

target: Завтра бабушка поёт песню в музее.
english: Tomorrow grandmother sings a song in the museum.

target: Вечером дедушка моет посуду в школе.
english: In the evening grandfather washes dishes at school.

target: Редко сестра рисует картину в парке.
english: Rarely sister paints a picture in the park.

target: Ей нужно купить три килограмма яблок.
english: She needs to buy three kilograms of apples.

target: Студенты на прошлой неделе гуляли в парке.
english: The students walked in the park last week.
grammar: Студенты гуляли = students walked (past plural -ли). На прошлой неделе = last week. В парке = in the park.

target: В понедельник музыкант играет в шахматы в школе.
english: On monday the musician plays chess at school.
This movie is more interesting than the previous one.
grammar: Comparative forms: -ее (длиннее) or prefix по- (подлиннее, colloquial).

target: Дедушка гуляет в парке перед завтраком.
english: Grandpa takes a walk in the park before breakfast.

target: Друг иногда танцует вальс в парке.
english: The friend sometimes dances a waltz in the park.

target: Инженер танцует вальс на пляже завтра.
english: The engineer dances a waltz at the beach tomorrow.

target: Сосед обычно танцует вальс на вокзале.
english: The neighbor usually dances a waltz at the station.

target: Я открыл окно и проветрил комнату.
english: I opened the window and aired out the room.

target: После обеда журналист рисует картину дома.
english: After lunch the journalist paints a picture at home.
grammar: После обеда = after lunch (после + genitive). Дома = at home. Рисовать картину = to paint a picture (imperfective).

target: Обычно полицейский убирает квартиру в больнице.
english: Usually the policeman cleans the apartment at the hospital.

target: Скоро полицейский помогает другу в аэропорту.
english: Soon the policeman helps a friend at the airport.
grammar: Скоро (soon) indicates near-future action. Помогать + dative: помогает другу. В аэропорту uses irregular prepositional -у.

target: Завтра врач помогает другу в театре.
english: Tomorrow the doctor helps a friend in the theater.
grammar: Завтра (tomorrow) with present tense for scheduled events. Помогать + dative: помогает другу. В театре = in the theater.

target: Перед сном бабушка учит язык в магазине.
english: Before bed grandmother studies a language in the store.
grammar: Перед сном = before sleep (перед + instrumental). В магазине = in the store. Учить язык = to study a language.

target: Сейчас медсестра ездит на работу в библиотеке.
english: Now the nurse commutes to work in the library.

target: В понедельник брат рисует картину в студии.
english: On monday brother paints a picture in the studio.
grammar: В понедельник = on Monday (в + accusative for days). В студии = in the studio (prepositional). Рисует is imperfective present.

target: Сегодня утром водитель читает книгу на работе.
english: This morning the driver reads a book at work.
grammar: Сегодня утром = this morning. Читает книгу = reads a book (imperfective present for current action). На работе = at work.

target: Я читал эту книгу, но не прочитал её.
english: I was reading this book but didn't finish it.
grammar: Imperfective describes ongoing or repeated actions: Я читал каждый день.

target: Мама танцует вальс в парке вечером.
english: Mom dances a waltz in the park in the evening.

target: Астроном наблюдал комету через мощный телескоп обсерватории.
english: The astronomer observed a comet through the observatory's powerful telescope.
grammar: На + prepositional = location 'on/at': на столе, на работе.

target: По выходным архитектор поёт песню в магазине.
english: On weekends the architect sings a song in the store.
grammar: По выходным = on weekends (по + dative plural). Петь песню = to sing a song. В магазине = in the store.

target: В понедельник водитель рисует картину на рынке.
english: On monday the driver paints a picture at the market.

target: Сегодня утром водитель танцует вальс на вечеринке.
english: This morning the driver dances a waltz at the party.

target: После обеда фермер пишет письмо в горах.
english: After lunch the farmer writes a letter in the mountains.

target: По выходным программист читает книгу на рынке.
english: On weekends the programmer reads a book at the market.
grammar: По выходным = on weekends (по + dative plural). Читать книгу = to read a book. На рынке = at the market.

target: Сегодня утром учитель пишет письмо в парке.
english: This morning the teacher writes a letter in the park.
grammar: Сегодня утром = this morning. Писать письмо = to write a letter. В парке = in the park (prepositional).

target: Перед сном медсестра помогает другу на вокзале.
english: Before bed the nurse helps a friend at the station.

target: Вечером студент танцует вальс на вечеринке.
english: In the evening the student dances a waltz at the party.
grammar: Вечером = in the evening (instrumental for time). Танцевать вальс = to dance a waltz (imperfective present). На вечеринке = at the party.

target: По выходным студент бегает утром в парке.
english: On weekends the student runs in the morning in the library.

target: Оазис посреди пустыни дарит тень и прохладную воду.
english: The oasis in the middle of the desert offers shade and cool water.
grammar: Some masculine nouns take stressed -у in prepositional: в лесу (in the forest), в саду (in the garden).

english: They will finish work.
grammar: Закончат is perfective future of закончить – they will finish (completed). Perfective verbs conjugated directly form the future tense.

english: Summer will come soon.
I will definitely come.
She will return soon.
grammar: Вернётся is perfective future reflexive of вернуться – she will return. Скоро (soon) + perfective future = imminent completed action.

english: You will study Russian.
grammar: Завтра (tomorrow) often signals future tense in Russian.

english: We will study together.
grammar: Imperfective future uses буду + infinitive: буду читать.

english: She often bought dinner.
He bought immediately dinner.
We will play football.
He will write a letter.
grammar: Perfective future uses the perfective verb directly: прочитаю.

english: She will learn the poem.
We will clean the apartment.
Pigeons sit on the roof.
I will listen to music.
grammar: Буду слушать is imperfective future (буду + infinitive): I will be listening. Used for ongoing or habitual future actions.

english: He will listen to music.
grammar: Imperfective future uses буду + infinitive: буду читать.

english: She will watch a movie.
They will watch a movie.
You will write a letter.
grammar: Imperfective future uses буду + infinitive: буду читать.

english: You will listen to music.
grammar: Будешь слушать is imperfective future (будешь + infinitive): you will be listening. Будешь = second person of буду.

english: He will solve this problem.
When will you finish work?
I sometimes cooked a book.
She cooked quickly a book.
We finally cooked a book.
She often learned a house.
You rarely learned a house.
We finally learned a house.
He learned immediately a house.
We usually opened a rule.
You rarely opened a rule.
grammar: Открывал is past imperfective – opened repeatedly. Редко (rarely) confirms habitual past action: you rarely used to open.

english: We finally opened a rule.
She often closed a letter.
We usually closed a letter.
He closed immediately a letter.
We finally closed a letter.
I sometimes decided a book.
She decided quickly a book.
She forgot her keys today.
grammar: Perfective describes completed, one-time actions: Я прочитал книгу.

english: We say goodbye to friends.
I remember about our conversation.
grammar: В + prepositional = location 'in/at': в школе, в городе.

english: We will watch a movie tonight.
Beautiful roses bloom in the park.
Rare animals live on the island.
She takes care of her parents.
grammar: При + prepositional = 'in the presence of/during': при свидетелях.

english: I will walk in the park.
We spent vacation at the sea.
Mom rarely swims in the pool.
He cooked all day a book.
He decided all day a book.
Soon the policeman commutes to work.
I often swimed to the restaurant.
I often leaded to the restaurant.
We went to the museum yesterday.
grammar: Animate accusative = genitive for masculine and plural: Я вижу друга (I see a friend).

english: Tomorrow grandfather washes dishes at home.
grammar: Завтра (tomorrow) + present tense for scheduled future. Мыть посуду = to wash dishes. Дома = at home.

english: They bought for a long time dinner.
They explained in the morning a rule.
They answered in the morning a letter.
grammar: Ответили is past plural perfective of ответить – they answered (completed). Утром = in the morning.

english: They showed in the morning a house.
They forgot in the morning a house.
It's quiet and calm in the library.
grammar: Masculine/neuter endings: -е (городе, окне). Feminine: -е (школе) or -и (ночи).

english: A soft carpet lies on the floor.
The professor gives a lecture about physics.
grammar: Prepositional case is ONLY used with prepositions: в, на, о, при.

english: A winter coat hangs in the wardrobe.
I used to buy groceries every day.
Soon the teacher does laundry at home.
Usually the teacher washes dishes at home.

target: Музыкант играет на гитаре в метро.
english: The musician plays guitar in the subway.

target: Светлое будущее ждёт каждого из нас.
english: A bright future awaits each of us.
grammar: Comparative forms: -ее (длиннее) or prefix по- (подлиннее, colloquial).

target: Мама покупает свежие овощи на рынке.
english: Mom buys fresh vegetables at the market.

target: Скоро дедушка стирает одежду на вокзале.
english: Soon grandfather does laundry at the station.

target: Часто папа покупает продукты в магазине.
english: Often dad buys groceries in the store.
grammar: Часто (often) signals habitual action. Покупать продукты = to buy groceries. В магазине = in the store (prepositional).

target: В следующем году я поеду в Россию.
english: Next year I will go to Russia.
They cooked for a long time a book.
They learned for a long time a house.
They opened for a long time a rule.
They closed for a long time a letter.
They decided for a long time a book.
grammar: Решали is past imperfective – they were solving for a long time. Долго (for a long time) pairs with imperfective aspect.

english: The boy feeds the fish in the aquarium.
A tall man is standing at the entrance.
A bottle of milk is in the fridge.
She will bake a cake for the holiday.
grammar: The perfective future looks like present tense but has future meaning.

english: The taxi is taking us to the airport.
grammar: Везти means transporting (one direction); возить means transporting regularly.

target: Вкусный торт стоит на праздничном столе.
english: A delicious cake is on the festive table.

target: Острый нож лежит на разделочной доске.
english: A sharp knife lies on the cutting board.

target: Я заканчивал работу поздно каждый день.
english: I used to finish work late every day.

target: Сегодня утром повар бегает в парке.
english: This morning the chef runs in the park.
grammar: Сегодня утром = this morning. Бегать = to run (multidirectional, habitual). В парке = in the park (prepositional).

target: Перед сном фермер плавает в бассейне.
english: Before bed the farmer swims in the pool.

target: Иногда папа учит язык в аэропорту.
english: Sometimes dad studies a language at the airport.
grammar: Иногда (sometimes) signals occasional action. Учить язык = to study a language. В аэропорту uses irregular prepositional -у.

target: Каждый день ребёнок плавает в бассейне.
english: Every day the child swims in the pool.

target: Обычно водитель покупает продукты в больнице.
english: Usually the driver buys groceries at the hospital.
grammar: Обычно (usually) signals habitual action. Покупать продукты = to buy groceries. В больнице = in the hospital.

target: После обеда ребёнок плавает в бассейне.
english: After lunch the child swims in the pool.
grammar: После обеда = after lunch (после + genitive). Плавать = to swim (multidirectional, habitual). В бассейне = in the pool.

target: Девочка часто играет в шахматы в библиотеке.
english: The girl often plays chess in the library.

target: Завтра водитель играет в шахматы в музее.
english: Tomorrow the driver plays chess in the museum.
grammar: Завтра (tomorrow) + present tense for planned future. Играть в шахматы = to play chess. В музее = in the museum.

english: The dog waits for its owner at the door.

target: Ключи от квартиры лежат на полке.
english: The keys to the apartment are on the shelf.

target: Музыкант обычно слушает музыку на пляже.
english: The musician usually listens to music at the beach.

target: Иногда врач пишет письмо в горах.
english: Sometimes the doctor writes a letter in the mountains.

target: Сегодня утром архитектор убирает квартиру дома.
english: This morning the architect cleans the apartment at home.

target: Скоро студент работает в офисе дома.
english: Soon the student works in the office at home.

target: Обычно медсестра рисует картину в магазине.
english: Usually the nurse paints a picture in the store.

target: Часто спортсмен поёт песню в ресторане.
english: Often the athlete sings a song in the restaurant.
grammar: Часто (often) signals habitual action. Петь песню = to sing a song. В ресторане = in the restaurant (prepositional).

target: Завтра музыкант танцует вальс в магазине.
english: Tomorrow the musician dances a waltz in the store.

target: Часто ребёнок убирает квартиру в больнице.
english: Often the child cleans the apartment at the hospital.
grammar: за + accusative = 'in the course of': за неделю (within a week).

target: Она искала ключи и наконец нашла их.
english: She was looking for keys and finally found them.
grammar: Many perfective verbs are formed by adding a prefix: писать → написать.

target: Перед сном папа слушает музыку в магазине.
english: Before bed dad listens to music in the store.

target: Сегодня утром музыкант слушает музыку в школе.
english: This morning the musician listens to music at school.
grammar: Сегодня утром = this morning. Слушать музыку = to listen to music. В школе = at school (prepositional for location).

target: Сегодня утром программист ездит на работу в школе.
english: This morning the programmer commutes to work at school.
A white cat is more beautiful than a black one.

target: Тень большого дерева падает на дорожку.
english: The shadow of a large tree falls on the path.

target: Вечером повар поёт песню на работе.
english: In the evening the chef sings a song at work.
grammar: Вечером = in the evening (instrumental for time). На работе = at work (prepositional for location). Поёт is imperfective present.

target: В понедельник спортсмен убирает квартиру на вокзале.
english: On monday the athlete cleans the apartment at the station.
grammar: В понедельник = on Monday (accusative for days). На вокзале = at the station. Убирать квартиру = to clean (imperfective).

target: По выходным студент рисует картину в парке.
english: On weekends the student paints a picture in the park.
grammar: По выходным = on weekends (по + dative plural). В парке = in the park. Рисует is imperfective present.

target: По выходным библиотекарь танцует вальс на вокзале.
english: On weekends the librarian dances a waltz at the station.

target: На прошлой неделе директор бегал утром дома.
english: Last week the director ran in the morning at home.

target: Сантехник установил новую систему отопления в подвале.
english: The plumber installed a new heating system in the basement.
grammar: Установить means 'to install.' Новую систему is accusative feminine – both adjective and noun change as direct object. В подвале = in the basement.

target: По выходным программист рисует картину в театре.
english: On weekends the programmer paints a picture in the theater.

target: Сегодня утром архитектор смотрит фильм в магазине.
english: This morning the architect watches a movie in the store.

target: Мы живём в центре города рядом с парком.
english: We live in the city center next to the park.

target: На прошлой неделе директор пел песню на вокзале.
english: Last week the director sang a song at the station.
grammar: На прошлой неделе = last week. Пел is past masculine imperfective of петь – singing was in progress. На вокзале = at the station.

target: На прошлой неделе спортсмен убирал квартиру в больнице.
english: Last week the athlete cleaned the apartment at the hospital.

target: После обеда архитектор ездит на работу в аэропорту.
english: After lunch the architect commutes to work at the airport.

target: Перед сном друг ездит на работу в больнице.
english: Before bed the friend commutes to work at the hospital.

target: Он решал задачу час и решил её.
english: He was solving the problem for an hour and solved it.

target: Она писала письмо весь вечер, но не написала его.
english: She was writing a letter all evening but didn't finish it.

target: Фламинго стоит часами на одной ноге в мелкой воде.
english: The flamingo stands for hours on one leg in shallow water.

target: Приветствую, давно вас не видел в городе!
english: Greetings, I haven't seen you in the city for a long time!
grammar: Здравствуйте is formal; use Привет with friends.

target: Я готовил суп долго и наконец приготовил его.
english: I was cooking soup for a long time and finally cooked it.

target: Тундра оживает летом, когда тают снега и расцветают цветы.
english: The tundra comes alive in summer when snows melt and flowers bloom.

target: Борец завоевал золотую медаль на Олимпийских играх в Токио.
english: The wrestler won the gold medal at the Olympic Games in Tokyo.

target: Ёж прячется днём под кучей листвы в саду.
english: The hedgehog hides during the day under a pile of leaves in the garden.
grammar: О + prepositional = about: о книге (about the book), о друге (about a friend).

english: The bus transports passengers.
We usually wrote work.
I sometimes wrote work.
He wrote immediately work.
She wrote quickly work.
Grandfather runs in the afternoon.
The athlete sometimes washes dishes.
Brother always paints a picture.
The farmer rarely does laundry.
The salesman washes dishes tomorrow.
grammar: Завтра (tomorrow) with present tense for planned future. Мыть посуду = to wash dishes (imperfective for habitual).

english: Grandmother usually dances a waltz.
grammar: Обычно (usually) signals habitual action. Танцевать вальс = to dance a waltz. Бабушка + третье лицо: танцует.

english: The policeman always cooks lunch.
grammar: Всегда (always) signals permanent habitual action with imperfective: всегда готовит обед = always cooks lunch.

english: We usually did an exercise.
We finally did an exercise.
He did immediately an exercise.
You rarely built a lesson.
She often built a lesson.
We usually built a lesson.
He built immediately a lesson.
grammar: Построил is past masculine perfective – completed building. Сразу means 'immediately/right away.'

english: We finally built a lesson.
We usually explained a rule.
She often explained a rule.
He explained immediately a rule.
She explained quickly a rule.
She often received a poem.
grammar: Получала is past imperfective – she used to receive (repeatedly). Часто (often) signals habitual past action.

english: I sometimes received a poem.
grammar: Получал is past imperfective – I used to receive (repeatedly). Иногда (sometimes) signals occasional past action.

english: She received quickly a poem.
He received immediately a poem.
She often answered a letter.
We usually answered a letter.
grammar: Отвечали is past imperfective plural – we used to answer. Обычно (usually) confirms habitual past action.

english: He answered immediately a letter.
She answered quickly a letter.
You rarely showed a house.
We usually showed a house.
grammar: Показывали is past imperfective plural – we used to show. Обычно (usually) signals habitual past action.

english: She showed quickly a house.
He showed immediately a house.
You rarely lost a task.
grammar: Терял is past masculine imperfective – you used to lose (repeatedly). Редко (rarely) signals infrequent past habitual action.

english: We finally lost a task.
He lost immediately a task.
grammar: Потерял is past masculine perfective – he lost (completed, one-time). Сразу (immediately) pairs with perfective for instant completion.

english: I sometimes found an exercise.
grammar: Находил is past masculine imperfective – I used to find (repeatedly). Иногда (sometimes) signals occasional past action.

english: You rarely found an exercise.
She found quickly an exercise.
He found immediately an exercise.
grammar: Нашёл is past masculine perfective of найти – he found (completed). Сразу (immediately) emphasizes instant result.

english: I sometimes forgot a house.
She forgot quickly a house.
We finally forgot a house.
She often forgot her keys.
grammar: Забывала is past feminine imperfective – she used to forget (repeatedly). Часто (often) signals habitual past action.

english: The students were answering questions.
He drives a car well.
grammar: Водить машину = to drive a car (habitual/skill). Водить is multidirectional – driving in general. Хорошо = well.

english: The train goes very fast.
She left her friend's place.
grammar: Уйти от + genitive = to leave from: ушла от подруги. Prefix у- means 'away.' От marks the person/place left behind.

english: Mom cooks lunch after lunch.
grammar: После обеда = after lunch (после + genitive). Готовить обед = to cook lunch (imperfective for habitual action).

english: He wrote all day work.
grammar: Писал is past imperfective – he was writing all day. Весь день (all day) signals extended duration, pairing with imperfective.

english: We started work on Monday.
Do you know this person?
grammar: Знаете ли вы – ли is a question particle making this a formal question: 'Do you know?' Этого человека uses animate accusative = genitive.

target: Дедушка играет в шахматы после обеда.
english: Grandfather plays chess after lunch.

target: Дедушка готовил обед на прошлой неделе.
english: Grandfather cooked lunch last week.
The director runs in the afternoon.
The policeman runs in the afternoon.
What is the weather like today?
grammar: Какая agrees with погода (feminine): Какая сегодня погода? = What is the weather like today? Какой/какая/какое/какие for gender.

english: The student usually paints a picture.
The farmer rarely cleans the apartment.
The engineer paints a picture soon.
grammar: Скоро (soon) indicates near-future action. Рисовать картину = to paint a picture (imperfective).

english: The boy reads a book soon.
The neighbor paints a picture now.
The journalist rarely helps a friend.
The musician always helps a friend.
The friend helps a friend now.
The teacher dances a waltz now.
grammar: Сейчас (now) marks present continuous. Танцевать вальс = to dance a waltz (imperfective present action).

english: The boy kept losing toys constantly.
The boy lost his favorite toy.
Why is it so cold here?
grammar: Почему means 'why' (asking for the cause): Почему здесь так холодно? Так means 'so' intensifying the adjective холодно.

english: I will need an umbrella today.
grammar: Feminine dative: -е/-и: сестра→сестре, мать→матери.

english: The artist always helps a friend.
grammar: Всегда (always) signals permanent habitual action. Помогать + dative: помогает другу = helps a friend.

english: One time is enough to understand.
The child washes dishes on weekends.
grammar: По выходным = on weekends (по + dative plural). Мыть посуду = to wash dishes (imperfective for habitual).

english: The programmer washes dishes this morning.
grammar: Сегодня утром = this morning. Мыть посуду = to wash dishes. Моет is third person singular of мыть.

english: My mom makes the best borscht.
He did all day an exercise.
He explained all day a rule.
grammar: Объяснял is past imperfective – he was explaining all day. Весь день (all day) signals extended duration with imperfective.

english: He answered all day a letter.
grammar: Отвечал is past imperfective – he was answering all day. Весь день signals extended duration with imperfective.

english: He found all day an exercise.
grammar: Находил is past imperfective – he was finding all day. Весь день signals extended duration with imperfective.

english: He forgot all day a house.
grammar: Забывал is past imperfective – he kept forgetting. Весь день (all day) signals extended/repeated duration with imperfective.

english: I often went to the market.
She often go/drived to the hospital.
I often runed to the hospital.
She often runed to the store.
He often swimed to the airport.
grammar: Плавать is multidirectional swimming – for habitual or general swimming. Часто (often) confirms habitual action.

english: She often swimed to the airport.
He often carryed to the airport.
I often transported to the airport.
He often leaded to the store.
She often leaded to the store.
We often go to the theater.

target: Ребёнок готовил обед на прошлой неделе.
english: The child cooked lunch last week.
grammar: На прошлой неделе = last week. Готовил is past masculine imperfective of готовить – cooking as a past habitual action.

target: Бабушка рисовала картину на прошлой неделе.
english: Grandmother painted a picture last week.
grammar: Рисовала is past feminine imperfective (agreeing with бабушка). На прошлой неделе = last week.

target: Фермер готовил обед на прошлой неделе.
english: The farmer cooked lunch last week.
grammar: На прошлой неделе = last week. Готовил is past masculine imperfective. Фермер (farmer) is masculine.

target: Студент ответил на все вопросы правильно.
english: The student answered all questions correctly.

target: Тысяча девятьсот девяносто первый год был важным.
english: The year nineteen ninety-one was important.
grammar: Один agrees in gender: один дом, одна книга, одно окно.

english: The children are running to the playground.
The athlete paints a picture every day.
The artist paints a picture on Monday.
The friend helps a friend this morning.
Soon the chef does laundry at home.
Soon the director washes dishes at home.
Rarely the chef washes dishes at home.
The boy often went to the market.
The boy often swimed to the station.
The boy often transported to the hospital.
He is driving the children to school.
Mom is taking the child to kindergarten.
Rarely the child swims in the pool.
grammar: Редко (rarely) signals infrequent habitual action. Плавать = to swim (multidirectional, habitual). В бассейне = in the pool.

english: Tomorrow the writer does laundry at home.
It's fifteen minutes walk to the station.
We need to go to the doctor.
I gave the book to my brother.
grammar: Мой/моя/моё/мои change by gender and case: мой дом, моя книга, моё окно, мои друзья.

english: I need to renew my library card.

target: Музыкант рисовал картину на прошлой неделе.
english: The musician painted a picture last week.
grammar: Рисовал is past masculine imperfective of рисовать – drawing in progress or habitual. На прошлой неделе = last week.

target: Друг смотрел фильм на прошлой неделе.
english: The friend watched a movie last week.
grammar: Смотрел is past masculine of смотреть – he watched (past tense, not present). На прошлой неделе = last week.

target: По выходным мама моет посуду дома.
english: On weekends mom washes dishes at home.

target: Она ездила в Петербург на поезде.
english: She went to St. Petersburg by train.

target: Мы плавали в море каждое утро.
english: We swam in the sea every morning.

target: Мы делали уборку, но не сделали её до конца.
english: We were cleaning but didn't finish it.
grammar: Готовить (impf.) vs приготовить (pf.) – cooking vs having cooked.

english: The boy dances a waltz in the evening.
grammar: Вечером = in the evening (instrumental for time of day). Танцевать вальс = to dance a waltz.

english: They received for a long time a poem.
